scope_note: Exactly parts A, B, C and D as the launcher.command states: c in {13, 17, 19, 31}, 64 curves per prime per arm, seeds {1, 2, 3}, the matched random-prime arm, the ord_l(p) cap 10^6 on the four public deployed curves, norm boxes log2 B in {20, 30, 40} with 10^5 samples.
